description: This file defines the PostObject class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for S3 operations related to generating POST upload forms. It manages form attributes, inputs, and policies to facilitate browser-based uploads to S3 buckets.

classes.name: PostObject
classes.description: Handles the creation of a POST form for uploading files directly to an S3 bucket, including setting form attributes, inputs, and generating policies and signatures for the upload.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a PostObject instance with client, bucket, form inputs, and policy. Sets form attributes and inputs, and merges credentials-based policy/signature data.

methods.name: getBucket
methods.description: Returns the target S3 bucket name.

methods.name: getFormAttributes
methods.description: Returns the array of form attributes for the upload form.

methods.name: setFormAttribute
methods.description: Sets or updates a specific form attribute.

methods.name: getFormInputs
methods.description: Returns the form inputs as an array.

methods.name: setFormInput
methods.description: Sets or updates a specific form input.

methods.name: getJsonPolicy
methods.description: Returns the raw JSON policy used for the upload.

methods.name: generateUri
methods.description: Generates the upload URL based on client configuration and bucket name.

methods.name: getPolicyAndSignature
methods.description: Creates a base64-encoded policy and signature from credentials for form submission.
